name: Gravitational Field
description: Spacetime curvature intelligence governing mass attraction, orbital mechanics, and large-scale cosmic structure formation through geodesic flow.

core_attributes.pattern: mass attraction, geodesic curvature, orbital resonance

scope.definition: Precision of the weak equivalence principle — fractional difference in free-fall acceleration between test masses of different compositions (η = |a₁-a₂|/(a₁+a₂)/2), measured by torsion balance experiments.

evidence.source: Eötvös et al. (1922) 'Beiträge zum Gesetze der Proportionalität von Trägheit und Gravität', Annalen der Physik 68:11-66; Schlamminger et al. (2008) 'Test of the equivalence principle using a rotating torsion balance', Physical Review Letters 100:041101.
cross_domain_examples: Eöt-Wash torsion balance: η < 10⁻¹³ between beryllium and titanium test masses
lunar laser ranging: η < 10⁻¹³ between Earth-Moon system (includes quantum binding energy contribution)
STE-QUEST space mission: targeting η < 10⁻¹⁵ for matter-wave interferometry — next precision frontier

scope.falsifiability: If torsion balance experiments detect η > 10⁻¹¹ between standard composition test masses in vacuum, the equivalence principle requires extension.
scope.measurement_limits: Precision limited by thermal noise in torsion fiber, seismic vibration, and electrostatic patch potentials. Space measurements eliminate seismic noise; atom interferometry tests equivalence for quantum matter.
